requirements.title: Production authentication fails closed
requirements.criterion: Production refuses to start without a password hash and a session secret of at least 32 characters; authenticated routes use opaque server-side sessions.

requirements.title: Role-based authorization
requirements.criterion: Viewer, operator, and administrator roles have least-privilege route and action permissions, with mutation denied by default.

requirements.title: No arbitrary host command surface
requirements.criterion: Every host operation maps to a fixed adapter and script; request bodies reject unknown actions and extra command input.

requirements.title: Secrets and sensitive data remain isolated
requirements.criterion: Steam credentials, panel secrets, tunnel credentials, paths, raw logs, saves, player data, and production configuration never cross an unauthorized API or public-release boundary.

requirements.title: Managed process identity is exact
requirements.criterion: Lifecycle actions require a live PID whose executable exactly matches the configured DSP installation and managed PID record.

requirements.title: Lifecycle preview fails closed
requirements.criterion: Save, graceful-stop, restart, and start previews are authenticated, strict, audited, non-mutating, and fail closed unless fresh SYSTEM-broker evidence plus the durable execution lock satisfy the exact action.

requirements.title: Global execution lock and idempotency
requirements.criterion: A cross-process lock, request ID, idempotency key, bounded timeout, and terminal-state recovery prevent concurrent or duplicate lifecycle mutation.

requirements.title: Save acknowledgement is independently observable
requirements.criterion: A save request is associated with a versioned request ID and is successful only after an independent acknowledgement and stable paired-save observation.

requirements.title: Verified save transaction
requirements.criterion: Save creates durable phase receipts, verifies paired files, records an audit result, and has a tested rollback/protection-point path.

requirements.title: Verified graceful-stop transaction
requirements.criterion: Graceful stop uses an allowlisted adapter, preserves the verified save pair, emits durable receipts, and has a tested restart rollback.

requirements.title: Verified restart transaction
requirements.criterion: Restart performs save, stop, start, health verification, and rollback as one durable transaction sharing one protection point.

requirements.title: Interrupted jobs recover after control-plane restart
requirements.criterion: Queued or running mutations survive process or host interruption and reconcile to an explicit terminal state without repeating an unsafe phase.

requirements.title: Nebula save pairs are atomic inventory units
requirements.criterion: A save is recognized only as a matching .dsv and .server pair and raw save paths never leave the provider boundary.

requirements.title: Atomic paired backup with integrity manifest
requirements.criterion: A fresh backup is staged atomically, contains exactly one matching pair, and records byte lengths plus SHA-256 hashes in a versioned manifest.

requirements.title: Backup catalogue and retention
requirements.criterion: Operators can list, annotate, download, upload, verify, retain, and prune paired backups through bounded audited workflows.

requirements.title: Guarded restore transaction
requirements.criterion: Restore supports dry-run validation, prevents active writes, preserves the current pair, installs one verified pair atomically, and rolls back on failure.

requirements.title: Production restore drill
requirements.criterion: A real Dyson backup is restored and loaded successfully in a controlled drill with evidence retained outside the public repository.

requirements.title: DSP, Nebula, BepInEx, and plugin inventory
requirements.criterion: Installed versions and compatibility signals are discovered without exposing raw logs or paths.

requirements.title: Compatibility and release resolver
requirements.criterion: Available releases are resolved from verified sources and blocked when the DSP, Nebula, BepInEx, or plugin compatibility matrix is unsatisfied.

requirements.title: Staged transactional update
requirements.criterion: Verified component downloads are staged outside the active tree, protected by a fresh backup, activated atomically, and followed by health checks; the separate DSP path is a default-off official Steam-client handoff that accepts completion only after exact version, compatibility, and current-generation exact-save load proof.

requirements.title: Update rollback and smoke test
requirements.criterion: A failed update independently restores and re-reads component bytes, configuration, server mod lock, and paired save, then starts the previous component and proves the exact previous save loaded in the current generation; all five receipt surfaces must verify or recovery remains required.

requirements.title: Mod inventory, dependency, and conflict resolver
requirements.criterion: Installed and available mods are represented by source, version, hash, dependencies, conflicts, and server/client requirements.

requirements.title: Audited mod mutation and configuration
requirements.criterion: Install, update, enable, disable, configure, and remove are dry-runnable, protected, validated, audited, reversible, and expose strict durable-receipt lookup plus bounded history.

requirements.title: Reproducible server mod lock
requirements.criterion: The active server mod set has a deterministic lock file with hashes and a drift report against the live installation.

requirements.title: Client parity package
requirements.criterion: A client profile or package is generated from the same game, Nebula, BepInEx, mod, plugin, and configuration lock used by the server.

requirements.title: Player session inventory
requirements.criterion: Online state and join/leave history are collected only from a verifiable Nebula interface and minimize retained identity data.

requirements.title: Player moderation workflows
requirements.criterion: Whitelist, blacklist, permission, notice, kick, and ban actions exist only where supported and are role-gated, confirmed, and audited.

requirements.title: Player privacy controls
requirements.criterion: Player identifiers and network data are minimized, redacted by role, retention-bounded, export-controlled, and excluded from public diagnostics.

requirements.title: Durable structured log stream
requirements.criterion: Operators can follow bounded structured logs across browser reconnects without exposing unredacted host output.

requirements.title: Log filtering, download, and redaction
requirements.criterion: Logs support source, level, time, and text filters plus bounded download with tested secret and identity redaction.

requirements.title: Allowlisted console commands
requirements.criterion: The console exposes only typed, fixed commands with role checks, confirmation, audit, timeout, receipts, and no arbitrary shell escape.

requirements.title: Schema-based configuration and diff
requirements.criterion: Game, Nebula, BepInEx, plugin, mod, performance, and network configuration is parsed into typed schemas and previewed as a redacted diff.

requirements.title: Transactional configuration apply and rollback
requirements.criterion: Configuration changes are staged, validated, snapshotted, applied atomically, audited, and reversible without returning secret values.

requirements.title: Bounded host and game health inventory
requirements.criterion: CPU, processor groups, memory, process, task, storage, port, version, and save health are exposed as bounded validated summaries.

requirements.title: Unattended Windows service lifecycle
requirements.criterion: Dyson Control and DSP/Nebula start after Windows boot, need no RDP login, recover from crashes, and avoid duplicate instances.

requirements.title: Monitoring, alerting, and capacity history
requirements.criterion: Health, CPU, memory, disk, network, actual simulation UPS/TPS, save latency, backup latency, failures, and recovery attempts have retained metrics and actionable alerts.

requirements.title: Performance and stability qualification
requirements.criterion: Representative late-game saves pass documented actual Bridge UPS/TPS, save-latency, memory, disk, reboot, crash, and extended soak thresholds on the production VM.

requirements.title: Reusable installer, upgrader, migrator, and uninstaller
requirements.criterion: A clean supported Windows host can install, upgrade, migrate, roll back, and uninstall without production-specific paths or credentials.

requirements.title: Third-party deployment documentation
requirements.criterion: Architecture, prerequisites, configuration, operations, security, compatibility, troubleshooting, backup, restore, and recovery documentation supports a clean-room deployment.

requirements.title: Public release hygiene and provenance
requirements.criterion: Source, history, artifacts, screenshots, metadata, and dependency inputs are scanned for secrets and private data; releases are tied to an exact commit and published with hashes.

requirements.title: Side-by-side Dyson deployment
requirements.criterion: A release candidate runs on the Dyson VM against the configured data boundary while GSManager remains recoverable and production responsibilities are unchanged.

requirements.title: Authenticated TLS management endpoint
requirements.criterion: The production panel is reachable at the approved domain through TLS and authenticated routing while the Node listener remains loopback-only.

requirements.title: Game DNS and PassWall-bypass path
requirements.criterion: The final game address resolves dynamically, reaches the Nebula game protocol through a supported transport, and is proven not to traverse PassWall.

requirements.title: External client end-to-end join
requirements.criterion: A real external player resolves the address, authenticates, joins, interacts, triggers a verified save, disconnects, and reconnects successfully.

requirements.title: Production reboot, fault, and soak evidence
requirements.criterion: Windows reboot recovery, control-plane restart recovery, storage interruption, disk pressure, game crash, update rollback, restore, and sustained-operation drills pass with private evidence.

requirements.title: GSManager and production recovery package
requirements.criterion: GSManager, tasks, configuration, control data, and paired saves have a verified pre-cutover backup and documented restoration procedure.

requirements.title: Reversible production cutover
requirements.criterion: A declared maintenance window transfers domain and runtime responsibilities to Dyson Control, verifies service, and can revert without save loss.

requirements.title: GSManager removal and post-cutover acceptance
requirements.criterion: GSManager is removed only after observation and rollback drills pass; the final release, deployment baseline, evidence index, limitations, and runbook are delivered.
